# MistakesManager

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Mistakes.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Mistakes.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Mistakes/MistakesManager.cs#L38)
